title: Arrest Of Wanted Russian Named G.A. Efron

Seco.f, Cr. & Spl. Br.                                      7 April, 1943.

Efren Gers - Application for Firearm Licence.

EFRON Gersh Abramovich, Russian emigrant of
Jewish origin, married, jeweller and watchmaker by profes-
sion, born on 455:1888 in Vilna, Lithuania(formerly Russian
territory). According to his statement, he left Russia
(Vladivostok) in 1919, and proceeded to Japan and was
living in Yokohama for about one year, undergoing medi-
cal treatment, after being seriously wounded during the
civil war in Russia.
    In 1920, he arrived in Shanghai and for a short
period worked as watch repairor at Boyes . Bassett Ltd,
Hanking Rd, Shanghai.
    In 1922 he has opened his own jewellery shop
in Shanghai, Mingheng Rd and latter at Palace Hotel.
                                of
    In 1937 after the outbreak the hostilities in
Shanghai he liquidated his shop on Mingheng Rd, and since
that time operating only one shop at Palace Hotel.
    He visited on many occasions Chefoo, usually
during the summer, when American Navy was stationed there
and operated temporary business there selling stones etc.
to American sailors.
    In 1938 he made a trip to U.S.A. as he stated,
for medical treatment, returning to Shanghai in 1939.
    He is duly registered with the Russian Emigra-
nts' Committee and resides with his wife at Apt.304
Embankment Bldg. N.Soochow Rd.
    However enquiries shows, that the statement of
Mr.Efren, re. his movements, is very doubtful.
    According to Municipal Police records Mr.Efren
mentioned as suspected swindler, jewel smuggler and fence
page_data.zh:
等。

第二科，刑事及特别分部                                      1943年4月7日。

埃夫伦·格斯 - 枪支执照申请。

埃夫龙·格尔什·阿布拉莫维奇（EFRON Gersh Abramovich），犹太裔俄罗斯移民，已婚，职业为珠宝商和钟表匠，1888年出生于立陶宛维尔纳（前俄罗斯领土）。据其陈述，他于1919年离开俄罗斯（符拉迪沃斯托克/海参崴），前往日本，并在横滨居住约一年接受治疗，此前他在俄罗斯内战期间受重伤。
    1920年，他抵达上海，并在短时间内于上海汉口路博伊斯·巴塞特有限公司（Boyes . Bassett Ltd）担任钟表修理工。
    1922年，他在上海明恒路开设了自己的珠宝店，后来迁至华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）。
    1937年上海战事爆发后，他清算了明恒路的店铺，自此仅在华懋饭店经营一家店铺。
    他曾多次访问烟台，通常是在夏季，当时美国海军驻扎在那里，他在那里进行临时商业活动，向美国水手出售宝石等物品。
    据其称，1938年他前往美国接受治疗，并于1939年返回上海。
    他已在俄罗斯侨民委员会正式登记，与妻子居住在苏州河北路堤岸大厦304室。
    然而，调查显示，埃夫伦先生关于其行踪的陈述非常可疑。
    根据工部局警务处记录，埃夫伦被提及为涉嫌诈骗犯、珠宝走私者和销赃者

page_data.en:
-2-

In 1921 he was imprisoned in Harbin (charge
not mentioned). In March 1921 he was detained by Russian
Vice-Consul in Shanghai, on charge of Fraud and approp-
riation of a diamond ring, the property of Mrs Storliad-
kin. On 24.7.20, arrested for Fraud in Tientsin. Relea-
sed on security, to report himself to Russian Consulate
in Tientsin.
Detained in Chefoo on 3.6.35,, on suspicion of
being concerned in the "Bonnet Profits" Robbery, when he
was found in possession of 2 packages of jewellery, which
later were found to have been smuggled on his behalf to
Chefoo on an American ship. These jewels were proved to
have no connection with the above case and were after-
wards handed over to Customs.
On 25.8.40, Complt. Gus.J.Le Pella, American
seaman, accused Efren, for selling him one brass ring,
one pr. of cufflinks and 1 pr. of earrings, as genuine
solid gold, with intent to defraud Complt., well knowing
that the Complt. was a seaman passing through S'hai and
was not expected to report the matter to the Police.
(Central F.I.R.2669/40). As Complt. was sailing from
Shanghai and Efren was located by the Police after Compl-
ainant's departure from S'hai and denied charge, the case
was postponed until Complt.'s next visit to Shanghai,
moreover there was not sufficient evidence to charge
Efren with Fraud. Later ring etc, were handed over to
American shipping office, as was requested by them, as
Complainant was not expected to visit S'hai again.
page_data.zh:
-2-

1921年，他在哈尔滨入狱（罪名未提及）。1921年3月，他因欺诈和侵占斯托尔利亚德金夫人（Mrs Storliadkin）所有的钻石戒指，被驻上海的俄罗斯副领事拘留。1920年7月24日，在天津因欺诈被捕。获保释，条件是向驻天津俄罗斯领事馆报到。
1935年6月3日，在烟台因涉嫌参与“邦尼特利润”（Bonnet Profits）抢劫案而被拘留，当时发现他持有两包珠宝，后来查明这些珠宝是代表他通过一艘美国船只走私到烟台的。经证实，这些珠宝与上述案件无关，随后移交海关。
1940年8月25日，原告古斯·J·勒佩拉（Gus.J.Le Pella），美国海员，指控埃夫伦将一枚黄铜戒指、一对袖扣和一对耳环作为真纯金制品出售给他，意图欺诈原告，且明知原告是一名途经上海的海员，预计不会向警方报告此事。（中央 FIR 2669/40）。由于原告将从上海启航，且埃夫伦在原告离开上海后被警方找到并否认指控，案件推迟至原告下次访问上海时审理，此外也没有足够证据以欺诈罪起诉埃夫伦。后来，应美方要求，戒指等物品移交给美国航运办事处，因为预计原告不会再访问上海。

The required application for Firearm License,
is needed only for jewellery-shop protection. Applicant
does not keep any jewels at his residence and on leaving
his shop locked his pistol in the safe at the shop and
never carried pistol with him.

Efren's jewellery shop located at the Palace
Hotel, 23 Nanking Rd, occupying part of the room on the
ground floor of Hotel (between the lobby and lunch room)
Palace Hotel has one Russian Police (armed) watchman and
number private watchmen on duty and it is very doubtful
made
that any robbery attempt may be on the shop in Hotel.

所需的枪支执照申请仅用于珠宝店防护。申请人不在其住所存放任何珠宝，离开店铺时将手枪锁在店内的保险箱中，从不随身携带手枪。

埃夫伦的珠宝店位于南京路23号华懋饭店，占据酒店底层部分房间（在大堂和午餐室之间）。华懋饭店有一名俄罗斯警察（武装）看守和数名私人看守值班，因此酒店内的店铺遭到抢劫企图的可能性非常小。

Sir,

    Mr. Ivanoff states he is in possession of the

the Commissioner of Police write to him forwarding the letter

Prison.
Harbin, December 30, 1921. 90.

To the Shanghai Municipal
Police Administration.

A prisoner in my charge named Girsh Abramovitch
Efrom has informed me, that in March 1921 when he was
detained by the Russian Vice Consul in Shanghai, Mr. Iva-
noff, on a charge of fraud and appropriating diamond ear-
rings belonging to Mr. Sterliadkin, the above named Vice-
Consul seized the following documents belonging to Efrom:
A Foreign passport No.53, issued by the Omsk Dis-
trict Administration in 1918.
A professional certificate issued in the same year
by the Omsk Town Council.
A certificate to the effect that he had been woun-
ded, issued by the Imperial Red Cross Hospital.
He requests that these documents be sent to him.
I beg that the Police Administration will obtain
from the former Russian Vice Consulate the documents
mentioned and send them to me in order that I can hand
them over to Efrom.
In addition I should state that Efrom has on seve-
ral occasions made requests to the Vice Consul for the
documents, but the latter has given no reply.

Chief of the Prison
of Special District Eastern
Provinces
(signed)
Masgovoi

Secretary (signature)

August 31st 20

Sir,
In reply to your letter of the 15th instant, Reference
No.3173 requesting information regarding G.A. Efron,
I have the honour to inform you that according to
information received G.A. Efron is evidently in Tsingtao.
How he left Shanghai is not known, as his name cannot
be found in the passenger list at the Shipping Offices.
He left his lodgings at 72 Bubbling Well Road on the
1st instant. He engaged a carriage and gave the
mafoo instructions to take him to the Wayside wharf
but as no ship left from the wharf on that day or the
following day evidently this was done to cover his tracks.
It is believed that he left Shanghai by train.
As requested by you I have the honour to
enclose herewith six copies of the photograph of
G.A. Efron.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Commissioner of Police.

V. Grosse, Esq.,
Consul General for Russia,
Shanghai.

August 21st 19 20.
REPORT ON G.A.Efron.
Made by D.S.Schmidt. Forwarded by
Sir,
I beg to report, that the above named is evidently in
Tsingtau, according to information received. How he left
Shanghai is not known, as his name cannot be found in the
passenger list at the shipping offices. Apparently he
travelled under a assumed name, as his passport is still at
the Consulate. G.A.Efron left his lodgings at 72 Bubbling
Well Road, on the 1st inst. He engaged a carriage, and gave
the mafoo instructions to take him to the Wayside wharf, but
as no ship left from that wharf, on that day or the
following day, so evidently it was done to cover his tracks.
My belief is, that he left Shanghai by train.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant
D. S. Schmidt
Det.Sergt.113.
Director of Criminal Intelligence.
Seen by S. J. Reuss

August 19th, 1920.
No. [涂黑]

4341
9/1/22

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY.
No. 8260/2
DATE 16. 8. 20.

To the Commissioner of Police.
Shanghai. -
------------------

Sir:-

Referring to my letter of the 22nd of July,
1920, sub No 2773 on the subject of an arrest of
the Russian citizen G. A. Efron, I have the honour
to inform you that the above named Russian citizen
was duly brought before the judge on the 24th of
July, 1920. He delivered all his documents to the
Court and gave an undertaking in writing not to le-
ave his premises, No 72 Bubbling Well Road, Room 8,
without permission of the Court.- It appears now
that he has left said premises on or about the first
of August for an unknown destination.-

In consequence of the above I have the honour
to request that you will kindly verify the informa-
tion received and, if possible, ascertain on which
steamer Efron has left the Port.- Further I beg to
request that you will order for my account six more
photos of G. A. Efron.-

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,
[签名]
Consul-General for Russia.-

总部
中央登记处。
编号 8260/2
日期 20. 8. 16.

致警务处处长。
上海。 -
------------------

先生：-

关于我1920年7月22日第2773号信函，涉及逮捕俄罗斯公民G. A. 埃夫龙一事，谨此通知您，上述俄罗斯公民已于1920年7月24日正式被带上法庭。他将所有文件交给法院，并书面承诺未经法院许可不得离开其住所，即静安寺路72号8室。- 现在看来，他已于8月1日左右离开上述住所，去向不明。-

鉴于上述情况，谨此请求您核实收到的信息，并尽可能查明埃夫龙是乘坐哪艘轮船离开港口的。- 此外，恳请您下令为我额外拍摄六张G. A. 埃夫龙的照片。-

谨此致敬，
先生，
您的顺从仆人，
[签名]
俄罗斯总领事。-

July 26th 1920.

REPORT ON Russian Court Proceedings re Trial Of G.A.Efron.

Made by D.S.Schmidt. Forwarded by a/ Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,
I beg to report, that the above named has been released on security. He has to report, to the Russian Authorities at Tientsin for trial. It is alleged, that Efron had fraudulently obtained diamonds to the value of Yen 4000. from a Russian in Tientsin. Accused denies the charge.

I am Sir,
Your obedient servant
H. J. Schmidt
Det. Sergt. 113.

Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Ruth
7th

9/1/22
1920年7月26日。

关于 G.A.Efron 受审案的俄国法庭诉讼报告。

由 D.S.Schmidt 撰写。经代理刑事情报处处长转呈。

先生，
谨此报告，上述人员已获保释。他须向天津的俄国当局报到，接受审判。据称，Efron 以欺诈手段从天津一名俄国人处获取了价值4000日元的钻石。被告否认该项指控。

先生，
您忠实的仆人
H. J. Schmidt
警长 113号。

刑事情报处处长。

Ruth

C.P 8260
Shanghai Municipal Police.
4341
9/1/22
Hongkew Station.
July 23rd 19 20.
REPORT ON Arrest of wanted Russian, named G.A.Efron.
Made by D.S.Schmidt. Forwarded by a/ Director of Criminal Intelligence.
Sir,
I beg to report, that the above named wanted Russian, was located and arrested in his rooms at 72 Bubbling Well Road, at 12.30 p.m. this date. The House mentioned is a boardinghouse owned by Mrs.Hendricksen. Prisoner will be taken before the Russian Court on the 24th inst. D.S.Conduit assisted me in making the arrest.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant
H. J. Schmidt
Det.Sergt.113.
Director of Criminal Intelligence.
（批：Kno 24/20）

1920年7月23日。
关于逮捕被通缉的俄国人 G.A.Efron 的报告。
由 D.S.Schmidt 撰写。经代理刑事情报处处长转呈。
先生，
谨此报告，上述被通缉的俄国人于今日下午12时30分在其位于静安寺路72号的房间内被找到并逮捕。所述房屋为 Hendricksen 夫人所有的寄宿公寓。囚犯将于本月24日被提审至俄国法庭。D.S.Conduit 协助我执行了逮捕行动。
先生，
您忠实的仆人
H. J. Schmidt
警长 113号。
刑事情报处处长。
（批注：Kno 24/20）

To the Commissioner of Police.
Shanghai.-

Sir,

I have the honour to request that you will
order the Police to arrest and bring before the
Consular Court the Russian Citizen G.A.Efron char-
ged with fraud. He has left Tientsin on or about
the 12th inst. and it is said at present he is
residing at the Palace Hotel.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant
N. Gross.
Consul General for Russia.
